resources.string: JEV (TypeSafe AI) decides every tap. Add your own API key from console.typesafe.ai.
Using the key built into this debug build. Tap Change to use your own.

JEV is TypeSafe AI\'s \"System One\" model. For every step, Voice Control sends it a screenshot and JEV decides what to do next: which button to tap, what to type, when the task is done. The app calls JEV with your own API key, so TypeSafe bills your account directly: about $0.0002 per step, so a typical task costs well under one cent ($42 per billion input tokens).
1. Open the TypeSafe console and sign in (or create an account).\n2. On the API keys page, create a new key.\n3. Copy it, come back here and paste it below.
The key is stored encrypted on this phone (Android Keystore) and is only sent to api.typesafe.ai.
